displayName: Founder-Led Sales — Sell It Yourself Until It's Repeatable
description: Activate when: an early founder needs revenue but wants to hire a salesperson or 'automate' sales too soon; 'I hate selling', 'when should I hire sales?', first customers, pre-PMF go-to-market. Do NOT activate when: the company already has repeatable, documented sales and is scaling a proven motion (then it's about hiring/systems, not founder-led). More: deciqai.com/c/founder-led-sales
